title: Tell HN: OpenAI keeps re-enabling the 'allow training' setting
summary: A Hacker News user reports that OpenAI repeatedly re-enables the 'allow training' data-sharing setting after they disable it, despite carefully tracking resets. The post urges others to verify their own settings, sparking a large discussion (459 points, 180 comments) about privacy, consent, and default opt-in practices in AI services.
